# ===== One slot's roles ($N$ the slot; the arithmetic is sr_fleet_effects.txt's) =====
# Every variable of the slot cleared: an empty slot.
sr_fl_clear_at = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_dest } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_dest }

	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_fl_$N$_warned_quiet } clear_variable_list = sr_fl_$N$_warned_quiet }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_fl_$N$_warned_loud } clear_variable_list = sr_fl_$N$_warned_loud }
}

# The month's construction (local_var:sr_sc_points) into the ground reserve (6d,
# design § 15), shared by the build mix; it reaches orbit at full when launched.
sr_reserve_build = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_sc_mix_share_war > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_sc_share value = { value = local_var:sr_sc_points multiply = sr_sc_mix_share_war } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_war } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_war value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_war add = local_var:sr_sc_share }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_sc_mix_share_rapid > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_sc_share value = { value = local_var:sr_sc_points multiply = sr_sc_mix_share_rapid } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_rapid } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_rapid value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_rapid add = local_var:sr_sc_share }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_sc_mix_share_siege > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_sc_share value = { value = local_var:sr_sc_points multiply = sr_sc_mix_share_siege } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_siege } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_siege value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_siege add = local_var:sr_sc_share }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_sc_mix_share_carrier > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_sc_share value = { value = local_var:sr_sc_points multiply = sr_sc_mix_share_carrier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_carrier } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_carrier value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_carrier add = local_var:sr_sc_share }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_sc_mix_share_tender > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_sc_share value = { value = local_var:sr_sc_points multiply = sr_sc_mix_share_tender } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_tender } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_tender value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_tender add = local_var:sr_sc_share }
	}
}

# The whole reserve into the slot at Earth (a launch: sr_earth_orbit_effects.txt),
# at full, then its propellant, supply and marines to capacity, as a month
# docked at Earth would give it.
sr_fl_reserve_in_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_reserve_war_value > 0 }
		sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = war AMOUNT = var:sr_reserve_war }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_war } remove_variable = sr_reserve_war }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_reserve_rapid_value > 0 }
		sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = rapid AMOUNT = var:sr_reserve_rapid }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_rapid } remove_variable = sr_reserve_rapid }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_reserve_siege_value > 0 }
		sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = siege AMOUNT = var:sr_reserve_siege }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_siege } remove_variable = sr_reserve_siege }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_reserve_carrier_value > 0 }
		sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = carrier AMOUNT = var:sr_reserve_carrier }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_carrier } remove_variable = sr_reserve_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_reserve_tender_value > 0 }
		sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = tender AMOUNT = var:sr_reserve_tender }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_tender } remove_variable = sr_reserve_tender }
	sr_fl_fill_at = { N = $N$ }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_marines value = sr_fl_$N$_marine_capacity }
}

# Console: 100 strength of each role into the reserve (te_debug_space_race.6).
sr_reserve_debug_fill = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_war } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_war value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_war add = 100 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_rapid } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_rapid value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_rapid add = 100 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_siege } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_siege value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_siege add = 100 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_carrier } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_carrier value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_carrier add = 100 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_reserve_tender } } set_variable = { name = sr_reserve_tender value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = sr_reserve_tender add = 100 }
}

# Docked: each role regains local_var:sr_fl_share of its gap to full.
sr_fl_repair_roles_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_full_value subtract = sr_fl_$N$_war_value multiply = local_var:sr_fl_share add = sr_fl_$N$_war_value } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full_value subtract = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value multiply = local_var:sr_fl_share add = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full_value subtract = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value multiply = local_var:sr_fl_share add = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full_value subtract = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value multiply = local_var:sr_fl_share add = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full_value subtract = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value multiply = local_var:sr_fl_share add = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value } }
	}
}

# Out of supply: each role loses sr_fl_attrition_share, now and at full.
sr_fl_attrition_at = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war_full } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war_full multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full multiply = { value = 1 subtract = sr_fl_attrition_share } } }
}

# A battle's losses (local_var:sr_fl_loss, points of strength; design § 3): the
# screens (warships, rapid response) take them in proportion to
# their strength until they are gone, then the screened roles; of each role's
# cut, sr_fl_loss_destroyed_share is destroyed (now and full), the rest damage
# (now only). Nothing goes below 0.
sr_fl_take_losses_at = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_screens value = sr_fl_$N$_screen_strength }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_screened value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_strength subtract = local_var:sr_fl_screens } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_on_screens value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_loss max = local_var:sr_fl_screens } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_on_screened value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_loss subtract = local_var:sr_fl_on_screens max = local_var:sr_fl_screened min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_war_value > 0 local_var:sr_fl_screens > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cut value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_on_screens multiply = sr_fl_$N$_war_value divide = local_var:sr_fl_screens max = sr_fl_$N$_war_value } }
		sr_fl_cut_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = war }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value > 0 local_var:sr_fl_screens > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cut value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_on_screens multiply = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value divide = local_var:sr_fl_screens max = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value } }
		sr_fl_cut_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = rapid }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_siege_value > 0 local_var:sr_fl_screened > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cut value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_on_screened multiply = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value divide = local_var:sr_fl_screened max = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value } }
		sr_fl_cut_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = siege }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value > 0 local_var:sr_fl_screened > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cut value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_on_screened multiply = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value divide = local_var:sr_fl_screened max = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value } }
		sr_fl_cut_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = carrier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_tender_value > 0 local_var:sr_fl_screened > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cut value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_on_screened multiply = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value divide = local_var:sr_fl_screened max = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value } }
		sr_fl_cut_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = tender }
	}
}

# Console: 100 strength of each role (te_debug_space_race.6).
sr_fl_debug_strength_at = {
	sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = war AMOUNT = 100 }
	sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = rapid AMOUNT = 100 }
	sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = siege AMOUNT = 100 }
	sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = carrier AMOUNT = 100 }
	sr_fl_add_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = tender AMOUNT = 100 }
}

# ===== Merge and detach (design § 4) =====
# Slot n merges into the next of ours at its location: every number added, the
# drive the lower, propellant and supply the lower share of their capacities,
# then n is cleared. Detach: half of each role into the lowest empty slot.
sr_fl_1_merge_now = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		sr_fl_merge = { N = 1 M = 9 }
	}
}
sr_fl_1_detach_now = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_2_exists = yes } }
		sr_fl_detach = { N = 1 M = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_3_exists = yes } }
		sr_fl_detach = { N = 1 M = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_4_exists = yes } }
		sr_fl_detach = { N = 1 M = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_5_exists = yes } }

		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_6_exists = yes } }

		sr_fl_detach = { N = 1 M = 9 }
	}
}

sr_fl_merge_at = { sr_fl_$N$_merge_now = yes }
sr_fl_detach_at = { sr_fl_$N$_detach_now = yes }
# N into M: shares first, then the numbers, then N cleared.
sr_fl_merge = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity max = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity > 0 sr_fl_$M$_dv_value < { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_value divide = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity max = 1 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_endurance > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_supply_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_endurance max = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$M$_endurance > 0 sr_fl_$M$_supply_value < { value = sr_fl_$M$_endurance multiply = local_var:sr_fl_supply_share } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_supply_value divide = sr_fl_$M$_endurance max = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_war } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_war_full } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_marines_value add = sr_fl_$N$_marines_value } }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_drive_value < sr_fl_$M$_drive_value } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_drive value = sr_fl_$N$_drive_value } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_refit_until }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$M$_refit_until } var:sr_fl_$M$_refit_until < var:sr_fl_$N$_refit_until } }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_refit_until value = var:sr_fl_$N$_refit_until }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_supply value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_endurance multiply = local_var:sr_fl_supply_share } }
	sr_fl_clear_at = { N = $N$ }
	sr_loc_rebuild = yes
}
# Half of N into the empty M, at N's location, posture and shares.
sr_fl_detach = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity max = 1 } } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_loc value = var:sr_fl_$N$_loc }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_drive value = sr_fl_$N$_drive_value }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_posture value = sr_fl_$N$_posture_value }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_refit_until } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_refit_until value = var:sr_fl_$N$_refit_until } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_supply value = sr_fl_$N$_supply_value }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_marines_value multiply = 0.5 } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_marines_value multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_war value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_war multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_war_full value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_war_full multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war_full multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_rapid value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_rapid_full value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_siege value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_siege_full value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege_full multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_carrier value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_carrier_full value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_tender value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_tender_full value = { value = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender_full multiply = 0.5 } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
	sr_loc_rebuild = yes
}

# ===== Transfer (UI pass design § 6) =====
# Opening the popup (sr_fleet_xfer_open_sgui): each amount to half of the
# slot's, rounded, and the transfer bound for a new fleet, or with no slot
# free, for the first fleet of ours here.
sr_fl_1_xfer_open_now = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_war value = { value = sr_fl_1_war_value multiply = 0.5 round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_rapid value = { value = sr_fl_1_rapid_value multiply = 0.5 round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_siege value = { value = sr_fl_1_siege_value multiply = 0.5 round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_carrier value = { value = sr_fl_1_carrier_value multiply = 0.5 round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_tender value = { value = sr_fl_1_tender_value multiply = 0.5 round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_marines value = { value = sr_fl_1_marines_value multiply = 0.5 round = yes } }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_has_free_slot = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = var:sr_fl_1_loc }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 9 }
	}
}

sr_fl_xfer_open_at = { sr_fl_$N$_xfer_open_now = yes }

# A step (sr_fleet_xfer_step_sgui): scope:pick the role (1 war, 2 rapid, 3 siege, 4 carrier, 5 tender, 6 marines),
# scope:step its code (XF_STEPS: 1-4 take 1, 10, 100 or 1,000 off, 5 none;
# 6-9 add them, 10 all), the amount then held to 0 and what slot N has.
sr_fl_xfer_step_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 1 }
		sr_fl_xfer_step_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = war CODE = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 2 }
		sr_fl_xfer_step_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = rapid CODE = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 3 }
		sr_fl_xfer_step_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = siege CODE = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 4 }
		sr_fl_xfer_step_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = carrier CODE = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 5 }
		sr_fl_xfer_step_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = tender CODE = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 6 }
		sr_fl_xfer_step_role = { N = $N$ ROLE = marines CODE = 6 }
	}
}
sr_fl_xfer_step_role = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = -1 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = -10 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = -100 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = -1000 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = 1 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = 10 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = 100 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:step = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_$ROLE$ add = 1000 max = sr_fl_$N$_$ROLE$_value min = 0 } }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_xf_step_checked } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_xf_step_checked value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sr_xf_chk_slot value = $N$ }
			set_variable = { name = sr_xf_chk_role value = $CODE$ }
			debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN xfer_step_scope (a Transfer step reached its scripted GUI with no step code: the third AddScope, scope:step, did not arrive; fallback: pick = role x 100 + step code, docs/testing/solar-colonies-playtest.md) slot=[THIS.Var('sr_xf_chk_slot').GetValue|0] role=[THIS.Var('sr_xf_chk_role').GetValue|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
			remove_variable = sr_xf_chk_slot
			remove_variable = sr_xf_chk_role
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_xf_step_checked } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_xf_step_checked value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_xf_chk_slot value = $N$ }
		set_variable = { name = sr_xf_chk_role value = $CODE$ }
		set_variable = { name = sr_xf_chk_amount value = var:sr_det_amt_$ROLE$ }
		debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK xfer_step_scope (a Transfer step reached its scripted GUI with its step code: three chained AddScopes arrive) slot=[THIS.Var('sr_xf_chk_slot').GetValue|0] role=[THIS.Var('sr_xf_chk_role').GetValue|0] amount=[THIS.Var('sr_xf_chk_amount').GetValue|2] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
		remove_variable = sr_xf_chk_slot
		remove_variable = sr_xf_chk_role
		remove_variable = sr_xf_chk_amount
	}
}

# The Into buttons (sr_fleet_xfer_to_sgui): where the transfer goes, scope:pick
# 0 a new fleet, else that slot.
sr_xf_set_to = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_det_to value = 9 }
	}
}

# Transfer (sr_fleet_transfer_sgui): into the lowest empty slot (sr_det_to 0),
# or into that slot while it is still here.

	if = {
		limit = { sr_det_to_value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_2_exists = yes } }
			sr_fl_transfer_new = { N = 1 M = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_3_exists = yes } }
			sr_fl_transfer_new = { N = 1 M = 3 }

sr_fl_transfer_at = { sr_fl_$N$_transfer_now = yes }

# N into the empty M, Detach's shape: M at N's location, on its drive, posture
# and refit; then both fleets N's shares of propellant and supply, of their
# new capacities (with the roles halved, as Detach's, the same months). A
# source closing in (3) or interdicting (4) leaves M at Stand off (2): M gets
# no target (owner, 2026-10-31).
sr_fl_transfer_new = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_all value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_xf_left <= 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_all value = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_ships value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_strength }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_ships value = sr_fl_$N$_strength_full } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_marines value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_marines_moved }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_war value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_war }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_war value = sr_fl_$N$_war_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_rapid value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_rapid }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_rapid value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_siege value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_siege }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_siege value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_carrier value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_carrier }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_carrier value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_tender value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_tender }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_tender value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity max = 1 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_endurance > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_supply_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_endurance max = 1 } } }
	sr_fl_clear_at = { N = $M$ }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_loc value = var:sr_fl_$N$_loc }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_drive value = sr_fl_$N$_drive_value }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_posture value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_posture_value max = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_refit_until } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_refit_until value = var:sr_fl_$N$_refit_until } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_marines value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_war } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_war_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_war > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_war min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_rapid min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_siege min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_carrier min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_tender min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_marines_value add = local_var:sr_xf_marines } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_marines_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_marines min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_supply value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_endurance multiply = local_var:sr_fl_supply_share } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_supply value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_endurance multiply = local_var:sr_fl_supply_share } }
	sr_loc_rebuild = yes
}
# N into M, one of ours there, Merge's rules: with ships joining, M takes the
# slower drive, the later refit, and the lower of the two shares of propellant
# and supply; it keeps its posture. N, with nothing of its strength left, is
# cleared, as Merge did; else it keeps its shares, of its new capacities.
sr_fl_transfer_into = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_all value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_xf_left <= 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_all value = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_ships value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_strength }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_ships value = sr_fl_$N$_strength_full } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_marines value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_marines_moved }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_war value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_war }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_war value = sr_fl_$N$_war_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_rapid value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_rapid }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_rapid value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_siege value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_siege }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_siege value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_carrier value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_carrier }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_carrier value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_amt_tender value = sr_fl_$N$_xf_tender }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_now_tender value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_dv_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity max = 1 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_endurance > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_supply_share value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_supply_value divide = sr_fl_$N$_endurance max = 1 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_m_dv_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_m_dv_share value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_value divide = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity max = 1 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_m_supply_share value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_$M$_endurance > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_m_supply_share value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_supply_value divide = sr_fl_$M$_endurance max = 1 } } }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_ships > 0 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_dv_share < local_var:sr_xf_m_dv_share } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_m_dv_share value = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_supply_share < local_var:sr_xf_m_supply_share } set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_m_supply_share value = local_var:sr_fl_supply_share } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_drive_value < sr_fl_$M$_drive_value } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_drive value = sr_fl_$N$_drive_value } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_refit_until }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$M$_refit_until } var:sr_fl_$M$_refit_until < var:sr_fl_$N$_refit_until } }
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_refit_until value = var:sr_fl_$N$_refit_until }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_war } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_war_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_war_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_war > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_war min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = war_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_war min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_war_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_war_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_rapid min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = rapid_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_rapid min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_rapid_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_siege_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_siege min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = siege_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_siege min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_siege_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_carrier min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = carrier_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_carrier min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_carrier_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_all = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender_full AMOUNT = var:sr_fl_$N$_tender_full } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full value = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_xf_part value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full_value multiply = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender divide = local_var:sr_xf_now_tender min = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender } }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender }
		sr_fl_add_role_part = { N = $M$ VAR = tender_full AMOUNT = local_var:sr_xf_part }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_amt_tender min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_tender_full_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_part min = 0 } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_marines_value add = local_var:sr_xf_marines } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_marines value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_marines_value subtract = local_var:sr_xf_marines min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_xf_m_dv_share } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$M$_supply value = { value = sr_fl_$M$_endurance multiply = local_var:sr_xf_m_supply_share } }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_strength < sr_fl_minimum_strength }
		sr_fl_clear_at = { N = $N$ }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_dv value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_dv_capacity multiply = local_var:sr_fl_dv_share } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_supply value = { value = sr_fl_$N$_endurance multiply = local_var:sr_fl_supply_share } }
	}
	sr_loc_rebuild = yes
}

# ===== A slot and its location ($N$) =====
# On arrival, its posture: Station where we hold a colony (and at Earth), Stand
# off elsewhere (design § 6).
sr_fl_arrival_posture_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 sr_loc_held_inner = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 sr_loc_held_mars = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 sr_loc_held_asteroids = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 sr_loc_held_jupiter = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 6 sr_loc_held_saturn = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 sr_loc_held_uranus = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 sr_loc_held_neptune = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 sr_loc_held_kuiper = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 2 }
	}
}

# On arrival, contact for every world of ours at the location (slice 5's
# sr_site_contact_<key>), unless it is blockaded or occupied, or (6d) our
# Earth is blockaded: then none of our colonies has contact (design § 15).
sr_fl_arrival_contact_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_earth_blockaded = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_venus } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_venus value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_mercury } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_mercury value = te_history_month_index } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_olympus_mons value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_hellas_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_hellas_planitia value = te_history_month_index } }

			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_arcadia_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_arcadia_planitia value = te_history_month_index } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ceres } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ceres } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_ceres value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_vesta } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_vesta } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_vesta value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_psyche } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_psyche } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_psyche value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pallas } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_pallas } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_pallas value = te_history_month_index } }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hygiea } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_hygiea } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_hygiea value = te_history_month_index } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 }
			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_io } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_io value = te_history_month_index } }

			if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ganymede } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ganymede } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_ganymede value = te_history_month_index } }

# The panel's Go: the picked destination, flown if it may be.
sr_fl_go_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 1 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_earth = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 2 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_inner = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 3 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_mars = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 4 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 5 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 6 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_saturn = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = saturn CODE = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 7 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_uranus = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = uranus CODE = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 8 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_neptune = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = neptune CODE = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ = 9 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
		sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
	}
}

# The destination button: the next location, skipping where the fleet is.
sr_fl_step_pick_once = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 6 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 7 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 8 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = 9 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_step_pick_at = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = sr_fl_$N$_loc_value }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_pick value = var:sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ } }
	sr_fl_step_pick_once = yes
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_pick = sr_fl_$N$_loc_value } sr_fl_step_pick_once = yes }
	set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = local_var:sr_fl_pick }
}

# The destination popup's choice (UI pass design § 4): the location whose code
# is scope:pick (sr_fleet_set_dest_sgui). The step above runs from nowhere since
# the popups (sr_fleet_pick_sgui's effect): kept for a revert.
sr_fl_set_pick_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_dest_pick_$N$ value = 9 }
	}
}

# The slot into the location records (sr_loc_rebuild): where it is, or where
# it is bound and when it lands.
sr_fl_note_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_str value = sr_fl_$N$_strength }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = earth }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = inner }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = asteroids }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = jupiter }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 6 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = saturn }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = uranus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = neptune }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 }
			sr_loc_add_present = { LOC = kuiper }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_dest has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_arrive }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_arr value = var:sr_fl_$N$_arrive }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 1 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = earth }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 2 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = inner }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 3 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 4 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = asteroids }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 5 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = jupiter }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 6 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = saturn }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 7 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = uranus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 8 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = neptune }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = 9 }
			sr_loc_add_inbound = { LOC = kuiper }
		}
	}
}

# Land: every marine aboard, at the first world of ours there awaiting its
# garrison, else the first world of ours there (table order). Embark: ours
# from every world of ours there, up to the carriers' room.
sr_fl_land_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_venus }
			sr_fl_land_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = venus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_mercury }
			sr_fl_land_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = mercury }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } }
			sr_fl_land_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = venus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } }
			sr_fl_land_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = mercury }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_valles_marineris }
			sr_fl_land_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons } has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_due_olympus_mons }
			sr_fl_land_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons }

		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= this sr_site_marines_value_eris > 0 } sr_fl_embark_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = eris } }
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= this sr_site_marines_value_makemake > 0 } sr_fl_embark_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = makemake } }
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= this sr_site_marines_value_haumea > 0 } sr_fl_embark_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = haumea } }
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this sr_site_marines_value_sedna > 0 } sr_fl_embark_marines = { N = $N$ KEY = sedna } }
	}
}

# ===== Finders (country scope; the slot in local_var:sr_fl_n, 0 for none) =====
# The home fleet (design § 5): the lowest slot at Earth, not in transit or
# refitting; else the lowest empty slot, created at Earth; else none.
sr_fl_find_home = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_1_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_2_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_3_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_4_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_5_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_6_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_7_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_8_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 NOT = { sr_fl_9_refitting = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 0 }
		sr_fl_find_empty = yes
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 }
			sr_fl_by_local = { DO = new_at_earth }
		}
	}
}
# The lowest slot at Earth (marines coming home).
sr_fl_find_at_earth = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
	}
}
sr_fl_find_empty = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_1_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_2_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_3_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_4_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_5_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_6_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_7_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_8_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_9_exists = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
	}
}

# ===== The location records (design § 4; global, rebuilt by sr_loc_rebuild) =====
#   sr_loc_present_<loc>, sr_loc_strength_<loc>   fleets there and their strength
#   sr_loc_inbound_<loc>, _inbound_first_<loc>, _inbound_by_<loc>   as a world's
#   sr_loc_top_<loc>, sr_loc_second_<loc>        the strongest two powers there
# and on each power, sr_fl_at_<loc>, its strength there.
sr_loc_clear_records = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_earth } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_inner } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_mars } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_asteroids } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_jupiter } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_saturn } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_uranus } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_present_neptune } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_present_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_neptune } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_neptune } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_neptune } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_neptune } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_neptune } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_neptune }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_kuiper } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_by_kuiper }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_top_kuiper } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_top_kuiper }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_second_kuiper } remove_global_variable = sr_loc_second_kuiper }
}
sr_loc_clear_country = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_earth } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_earth }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_mars } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_asteroids } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_jupiter } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_saturn } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_uranus } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_neptune } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_kuiper } remove_variable = sr_fl_at_kuiper }
}

# The strongest two powers at each location, after the rebuild. Second place
# only where two powers are there: past the end of the list, position = 1
# caps to the last item, so a lone power was its own runner-up and the
# iterator logged `Given position was bigger than the list`
# (scripting_best_practices.md, ordered_scope_state clamps out-of-range).
sr_loc_rank = {
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_earth }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_earth
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_earth value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_earth count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_earth }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_earth
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_earth value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_inner
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_inner value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_inner
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_inner value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_mars }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_mars
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_mars value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_mars count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_mars }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_mars
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_mars value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_asteroids }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_asteroids
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_asteroids value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_asteroids count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_asteroids }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_asteroids
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_asteroids value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_jupiter }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_jupiter
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_jupiter value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_jupiter count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_jupiter }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_jupiter
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_jupiter value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_saturn }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_saturn
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_saturn value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_saturn count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_saturn }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_saturn
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_saturn value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_uranus }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_uranus
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_uranus value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_uranus count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_uranus }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_uranus
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_uranus value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_neptune }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_neptune
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_neptune value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_neptune count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_neptune }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_neptune
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_neptune value = this }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = sr_fleet_powers
		limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_kuiper }
		order_by = var:sr_fl_at_kuiper
		position = 0
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_top_kuiper value = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_global_list = { variable = sr_fleet_powers is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_kuiper count >= 2 } }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_variable = sr_fl_at_kuiper }
			order_by = var:sr_fl_at_kuiper
			position = 1
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_loc_second_kuiper value = this }
		}
	}
}

# Players: the strongest other power's capital at each location, for its flag
# (gui_modding_guide.md gotcha #15: a country is read through a stored state).
sr_loc_refresh_snapshot = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_earth ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_earth = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_earth value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_earth ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }

# way; not one closing in on a lunar world (lunar colonization § 8.4). One
# order a month.
