# A fleet away from Earth with nothing to do there (no garrison due, no world of
# ours under threat, and (6c) no enemy world it is attacking while its fleets
# there are a match for the enemy's) comes home when it can.
sr_fl_ai_home_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc NOT = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 } sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_earth = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_inner = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_inner = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_inner = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_mars = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_mars = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_mars = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_asteroids = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_asteroids = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_asteroids = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_jupiter = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_jupiter = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_jupiter = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 6 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_saturn = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_saturn = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_saturn = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_uranus = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_uranus = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_uranus = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_neptune = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_neptune = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_neptune = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_kuiper = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_kuiper = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_kuiper = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# A slot's target world (its index): gathered, its Defences' losses, checked.
sr_fl_gather_target_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_add_target = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }

	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }

		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 27 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = ariel }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 28 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = triton }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 29 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = proteus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 30 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = pluto }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 31 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = eris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 32 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = makemake }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 33 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = haumea }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 34 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = sedna }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 35 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = shackleton }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 36 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = peary }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 37 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = tranquility }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 38 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = marius_hills }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 39 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = daedalus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 40 }
		sr_cb_add_target_loss = { N = $N$ KEY = imbrium }
	}
}
sr_fl_check_target_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 3 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = hellas_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 4 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = utopia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 5 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = arcadia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 6 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = ceres }

	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 7 }

# Closing in on a free colony begins its price (sr_cb_charge_free).
sr_fl_charge_free_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_charge_free = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris INDEX = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }
		sr_cb_charge_free = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons INDEX = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 3 }
		sr_cb_charge_free = { N = $N$ KEY = hellas_planitia INDEX = 3 }

# The target button (6c): interdicting, the next world here it may interdict,
# at the interdiction's price when its holder is a new one; else the next
# hostile world.
sr_fl_step_target_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 4 }
		sr_fl_step_icpt_target_at = { N = $N$ }
		sr_fl_charge_icpt_at = { N = $N$ }
		sr_icpt_rebuild = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_fl_step_hostile_target_at = { N = $N$ }
	}
}

# The target popup's choice (UI pass design § 7; sr_fleet_set_target_sgui): the
# world whose index is scope:pick, then the step's charge: interdicting, the
# interdiction's price when its holder is a new one; closing in, a free
# colony's. The scripted GUI holds the pick to the step's rule.
sr_fl_set_target_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 2 }

		limit = { scope:pick = 39 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 39 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 40 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 40 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 4 }
		sr_fl_charge_icpt_at = { N = $N$ }
		sr_icpt_rebuild = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 3 }
		sr_fl_charge_free_at = { N = $N$ }
	}
}

# The hostile step: the next hostile world at the slot's location after its
# target (table order), else the first; none clears it. At Earth, the lunar
# worlds (lunar colonization § 8.1). A free colony's price only while it closes
# in: a stationed fleet's target costs nothing.
sr_fl_step_hostile_target_at = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = var:sr_fl_$N$_target } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 0 }

		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 35 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 35 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 36 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 36 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 37 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 37 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 38 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 38 } }

			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 2 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 3 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 4 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 5 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 5 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 3 } }

# The interdiction's step (6c): the next world at the slot's location it may
# interdict, else the first; none ends the interdiction (it stands off).
# Never at Earth (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_step_icpt_target_at = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = var:sr_fl_$N$_target } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 17 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 17 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 18 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 18 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = venus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 17 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mercury } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 18 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 1 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 2 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 3 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 4 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 5 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 5 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 5 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 6 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ceres } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 6 } }

			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 15 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 16 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = io } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 11 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = europa } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 12 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ganymede } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 13 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = callisto } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 14 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = himalia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = amalthea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 16 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 6 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 19 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 19 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 20 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 21 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 21 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 22 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 22 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 23 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 23 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titan } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 19 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = enceladus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = rhea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 21 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = mimas } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 22 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = iapetus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 23 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 24 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titania } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 24 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 25 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = oberon } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 25 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 26 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = miranda } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 26 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 27 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ariel } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 27 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = titania } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 24 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = oberon } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 25 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = miranda } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 26 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = ariel } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 27 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 28 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = triton } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 28 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 29 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = proteus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 29 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = triton } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 28 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = proteus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 29 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 30 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pluto } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 30 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 31 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = eris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 31 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 32 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = makemake } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 32 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 33 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = haumea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 33 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 34 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = sedna } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 34 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = pluto } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 30 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = eris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 31 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = makemake } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 32 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = haumea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 33 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_interdict_target = { KEY = sedna } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 34 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = local_var:sr_fl_next }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 4 }
		sr_fl_end_icpt = { N = $N$ }
	}
}

# Interdicting the target world's holder begins its price (sr_cb_charge_interdict),
# once per fleet and target; checked monthly (sr_cb_check_icpt).
sr_fl_charge_icpt_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 3 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = hellas_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 4 }

sr_fl_check_icpt_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } }
		sr_fl_end_icpt = { N = $N$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 3 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = hellas_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 4 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = utopia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 5 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = arcadia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 6 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = ceres }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 7 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = vesta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 8 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = psyche }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 9 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = pallas }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 10 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = hygiea }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 11 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = io }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 12 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = europa }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 13 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = ganymede }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 14 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = callisto }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 15 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = himalia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 16 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = amalthea }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 17 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = venus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 18 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = mercury }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 19 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = titan }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 20 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = enceladus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 21 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = rhea }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 22 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = mimas }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 23 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = iapetus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 24 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = titania }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 25 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = oberon }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 26 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = miranda }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 27 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = ariel }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 28 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = triton }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 29 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = proteus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 30 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = pluto }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 31 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = eris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 32 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = makemake }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 33 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = haumea }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 34 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = sedna }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 35 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = shackleton }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 36 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = peary }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 37 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = tranquility }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 38 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = marius_hills }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 39 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = daedalus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 40 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = imbrium }
	}
}

# Country scope: our interdiction lists (sr_icpt_<loc>, the countries our
# fleets interdict at each location), rebuilt from every interdicting slot with
# the location records (sr_loc_rebuild) and on every posture or target order.
sr_icpt_rebuild = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_inner } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_mars } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_asteroids } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_jupiter } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_saturn } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_saturn }

# --- Earth and the Moon ---
sr_cb_clear_earth = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_present } remove_variable = sr_cb_present }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_s1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_s2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_s3 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_f1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_f1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_f2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_f2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_f3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_f3 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_e1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_e1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_e2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_e2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_e3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_e3 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_hs } remove_variable = sr_cb_hs }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_r1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_r1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_r2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_r2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_r3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_r3 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_l1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_l1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_l2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_l2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_l3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_l3 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_before } remove_variable = sr_cb_before }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_lost } remove_variable = sr_cb_lost }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_bs } remove_variable = sr_cb_bs }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_kf } remove_variable = sr_cb_kf }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_shackleton } remove_variable = sr_cb_s3_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_fd3_shackleton } remove_variable = sr_cb_fd3_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_mar_shackleton } remove_variable = sr_cb_mar_shackleton }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_fd3_peary } remove_variable = sr_cb_fd3_peary }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_ld_peary } remove_variable = sr_cb_ld_peary }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_fd3_tranquility } remove_variable = sr_cb_fd3_tranquility }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_dfd_marius_hills } remove_variable = sr_cb_dfd_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_ld_marius_hills } remove_variable = sr_cb_ld_marius_hills }

sr_cb_world_sums_earth = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_shackleton value = sr_cb_closing_shackleton }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_peary value = sr_cb_closing_peary }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_tranquility value = sr_cb_closing_tranquility }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_marius_hills value = sr_cb_closing_marius_hills }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_daedalus value = sr_cb_closing_daedalus }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_imbrium value = sr_cb_closing_imbrium }
}
sr_cb_world_clear_earth = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_shackleton } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_peary } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_tranquility } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_tranquility }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_marius_hills } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_daedalus } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_imbrium } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_imbrium }
}
# The power's losses to each world's Defences, by its share of the strength
# closing in on it.
sr_cb_def_losses_earth = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_shackleton has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_shackleton global_var:sr_cb_c_shackleton > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_shackleton value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_shackleton multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_shackleton divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_shackleton } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_peary has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_peary global_var:sr_cb_c_peary > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_peary value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_peary multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_peary divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_peary } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_tranquility has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_tranquility global_var:sr_cb_c_tranquility > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_tranquility value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_tranquility multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_tranquility divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_tranquility } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_marius_hills has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_marius_hills global_var:sr_cb_c_marius_hills > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_marius_hills value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_marius_hills multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_marius_hills divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_marius_hills } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_daedalus has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_daedalus global_var:sr_cb_c_daedalus > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_daedalus value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_daedalus multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_daedalus divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_daedalus } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_imbrium has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_imbrium global_var:sr_cb_c_imbrium > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_imbrium value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_imbrium multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_imbrium divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_imbrium } }
	}
}
sr_cb_worlds_after_earth = {
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = shackleton INDEX = 35 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = shackleton }
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = peary INDEX = 36 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = peary }
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = tranquility INDEX = 37 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = tranquility }
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = marius_hills INDEX = 38 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = marius_hills }
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = daedalus INDEX = 39 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = daedalus }
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = imbrium INDEX = 40 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = imbrium }
}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_l1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_l1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_l2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_l2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_l3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_l3 }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_lost } remove_variable = sr_cb_lost }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_bs } remove_variable = sr_cb_bs }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_kf } remove_variable = sr_cb_kf }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_venus } remove_variable = sr_cb_s3_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_fd3_venus } remove_variable = sr_cb_fd3_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_mar_venus } remove_variable = sr_cb_mar_venus }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_ld_venus } remove_variable = sr_cb_ld_venus }

	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_mercury value = sr_cb_closing_mercury }
}
sr_cb_world_clear_inner = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_mercury } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_mercury }
}
# The power's losses to each world's Defences, by its share of the strength
# closing in on it.
sr_cb_def_losses_inner = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_venus has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_venus global_var:sr_cb_c_venus > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_venus value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_venus multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_venus divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_venus } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_mercury has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_mercury global_var:sr_cb_c_mercury > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_mercury value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_mercury multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_mercury divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_mercury } }
	}
}

	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = mercury INDEX = 18 }
	sr_site_blockade_step = { KEY = mercury LOC = inner }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_callisto } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_amalthea } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_amalthea }
}
# The power's losses to each world's Defences, by its share of the strength
# closing in on it.
sr_cb_def_losses_jupiter = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_io has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_io global_var:sr_cb_c_io > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_io value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_io multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_io divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_io } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_europa has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_europa global_var:sr_cb_c_europa > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_europa value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_europa multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_europa divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_europa } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_ganymede has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ganymede global_var:sr_cb_c_ganymede > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_ganymede value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_ganymede multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_ganymede divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_ganymede } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_callisto has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_callisto global_var:sr_cb_c_callisto > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_callisto value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_callisto multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_callisto divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_callisto } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_himalia has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_himalia global_var:sr_cb_c_himalia > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_himalia value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_himalia multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_himalia divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_himalia } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_amalthea has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_amalthea global_var:sr_cb_c_amalthea > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_amalthea value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_amalthea multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_amalthea divide = global_var:sr_cb_c_amalthea } }
	}
}

	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = europa INDEX = 12 }

	}
}

# The seizer's marines spent at the world (local_var:sr_cb_pay), from its slots
# closing in on it to seize, in slot order.
sr_fl_spend_marines_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_1_target var:sr_fl_1_target = 1 sr_fl_1_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_destroy } sr_fl_1_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_1_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_2_target var:sr_fl_2_target = 1 sr_fl_2_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_destroy } sr_fl_2_marines_value > 0 }

sr_fl_ai_defend_inner = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_any_at_or_bound = { CODE = 2 } } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_fl_1_may_depart_inner = yes sr_fl_1_ai_free = yes sr_fl_1_ai_reaches_inner = yes sr_fl_1_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_1_strength }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_fl_2_may_depart_inner = yes sr_fl_2_ai_free = yes sr_fl_2_ai_reaches_inner = yes sr_fl_2_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }

			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {

# ===== The AI's offence (6c; sr_fl_ai_attack, sr_fleet_combat_effects.txt) =====

# it may attack and none of its fleets there or on the way, the strongest of
# its docked fleets free of the defence that reaches and outmatches it
# (sr_fl_<n>_ai_attacks_<loc>).

			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_6_strength }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_fl_7_ai_free = yes sr_fl_7_ai_attacks_kuiper = yes NOT = { sr_fl_7_closing_at_earth = yes } sr_fl_7_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_7_strength }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_fl_8_ai_free = yes sr_fl_8_ai_attacks_kuiper = yes NOT = { sr_fl_8_closing_at_earth = yes } sr_fl_8_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_8_strength }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_fl_9_ai_free = yes sr_fl_9_ai_attacks_kuiper = yes NOT = { sr_fl_9_closing_at_earth = yes } sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 6 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Lunar colonization § 8.4: at war, while no enemy's fleet is at Earth
# (sr_earth_hostile_present: a stationed one bars the seizure, sr_cb_seizes),
# first the enemy's lunar world of most worth (sr_site_ai_worth_<key>) that
# passes sr_site_ai_lunar_target, then the strongest of its fleets at Earth
# whose marines exceed that world's garrison and militia closes in on it to
# seize it; every other fleet of ours at Earth stays stationed (with none to
# close in, all of them). Never to destroy. Before the offence's dispatch,
# which leaves a fleet closing in at Earth where it is.
sr_fl_ai_lunar_assault = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_earth_hostile_present = yes } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_ai_worth_shackleton > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_shackleton } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 35 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_shackleton } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_ai_worth_peary > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_peary } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 36 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_peary } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_ai_worth_tranquility > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_tranquility } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 37 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_tranquility } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_ai_worth_marius_hills > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_marius_hills } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 38 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_marius_hills } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_ai_worth_daedalus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_daedalus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 39 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_daedalus } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = imbrium } sr_site_ai_worth_imbrium > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_imbrium } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 40 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_imbrium } }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ai_tgt > 0 }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_at_earth = yes sr_fl_1_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_1_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_1_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_at_earth = yes sr_fl_2_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_2_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_2_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_at_earth = yes sr_fl_3_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_3_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_3_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_at_earth = yes sr_fl_4_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_4_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_4_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_at_earth = yes sr_fl_5_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_5_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_5_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_at_earth = yes sr_fl_6_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_6_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_6_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_at_earth = yes sr_fl_7_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_7_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_7_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_at_earth = yes sr_fl_8_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_8_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_8_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_at_earth = yes sr_fl_9_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_1_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_1_destroy }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_posture value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_posture value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_1_target }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_2_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_2_destroy }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_2_posture value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_2_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_2_posture value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_2_target }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_3_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_3_destroy }
		if = {

			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_3_posture value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_3_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_3_posture value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_3_target }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_4_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_4_destroy }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_4_posture value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_4_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_4_posture value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_4_target }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_5_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_5_destroy }
		if = {

			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_5_posture value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_5_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_5_posture value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_5_target }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_6_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_6_destroy }
		if = {

			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_6_posture value = 3 }

# A slot at a location where we hold no threatened colony and there is a world
# it may attack: it closes in on the one of most worth (sr_site_ai_worth_<key>)
# to seize it when its marines exceed the world's garrison and militia, else it
# stands off and blockades. Never to destroy (design § 14).
sr_fl_ai_assault_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc NOT = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_ai_worth_venus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_venus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 17 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_venus } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = mercury } sr_site_ai_worth_mercury > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_mercury } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 18 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_mercury } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_ai_worth_valles_marineris > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_valles_marineris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_valles_marineris } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } sr_site_ai_worth_olympus_mons > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_olympus_mons } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 2 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_olympus_mons } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } sr_site_ai_worth_hellas_planitia > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_hellas_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 3 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_hellas_planitia } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } sr_site_ai_worth_utopia_planitia > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_utopia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 4 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_utopia_planitia } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } sr_site_ai_worth_arcadia_planitia > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_arcadia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 5 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_arcadia_planitia } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = ceres } sr_site_ai_worth_ceres > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_ceres } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 6 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_ceres } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = vesta } sr_site_ai_worth_vesta > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_vesta } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 7 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_vesta } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = psyche } sr_site_ai_worth_psyche > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_psyche } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 8 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_psyche } }

			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = hygiea } sr_site_ai_worth_hygiea > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_hygiea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 10 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_hygiea } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = io } sr_site_ai_worth_io > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_io } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 11 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_io } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = europa } sr_site_ai_worth_europa > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_europa } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 12 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_europa } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = ganymede } sr_site_ai_worth_ganymede > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_ganymede } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 13 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_ganymede } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = callisto } sr_site_ai_worth_callisto > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_callisto } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 14 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_callisto } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = himalia } sr_site_ai_worth_himalia > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_himalia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 15 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_himalia } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = amalthea } sr_site_ai_worth_amalthea > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_amalthea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 16 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_amalthea } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 6 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = titan } sr_site_ai_worth_titan > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_titan } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 19 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_titan } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = enceladus } sr_site_ai_worth_enceladus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_enceladus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 20 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_enceladus } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = rhea } sr_site_ai_worth_rhea > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_rhea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 21 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_rhea } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = mimas } sr_site_ai_worth_mimas > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_mimas } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 22 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_mimas } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = iapetus } sr_site_ai_worth_iapetus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_iapetus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 23 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_iapetus } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_ai_worth_titania > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_titania } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 24 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_titania } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_ai_worth_oberon > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_oberon } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 25 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_oberon } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_ai_worth_miranda > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_miranda } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 26 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_miranda } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = ariel } sr_site_ai_worth_ariel > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_ariel } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 27 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_ariel } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_ai_worth_triton > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_triton } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 28 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_triton } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = proteus } sr_site_ai_worth_proteus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_proteus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 29 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_proteus } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_ai_worth_pluto > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_pluto } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 30 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_pluto } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_ai_worth_eris > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_eris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 31 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_eris } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_ai_worth_makemake > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_makemake } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 32 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_makemake } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_ai_worth_haumea > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_haumea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 33 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_haumea } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = sedna } sr_site_ai_worth_sedna > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_sedna } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 34 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_garrison_need_sedna } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ai_tgt > 0 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_destroy }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_$N$_marines_value > local_var:sr_ai_need }
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 2 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Every fleet of ours in transit lands now.
sr_fl_debug_land_at = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_arrive } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_arrive value = te_history_month_index } }
	sr_fl_arrive_at = { N = $N$ }
}

# ===== The colonization overview's Defense list (audit SPC-6; display only) =====
sr_ov_list_defense = {
	if = { limit = { sr_earth_blockaded = yes } custom_tooltip = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_site_lost = yes } custom_tooltip = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_site_lost }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_shackleton }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_peary ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_peary }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_tranquility }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_marius_hills }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_daedalus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_imbrium }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ceres }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_vesta }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_psyche }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pallas }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hygiea }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_europa }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ganymede }
