					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_io }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_europa } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_europa }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ganymede } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_ganymede }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_callisto } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_callisto }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_himalia } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_himalia }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_amalthea } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_amalthea }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_venus }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_mercury }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titan } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_titan }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_enceladus } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_enceladus }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_rhea } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_rhea }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mimas } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_mimas }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_iapetus } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_iapetus }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_titania }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_oberon }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_miranda }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_ariel }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_triton } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_triton }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_proteus } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_proteus }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pluto } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_pluto }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_eris } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_eris }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_makemake } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_makemake }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_haumea } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_haumea }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_sedna } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_sedna }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip_no_bullet = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_calm
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_alert_arrive var:sr_fl_alert_arrive >= te_history_month_index }
		custom_tooltip_no_bullet = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_inbound
	}
}

# ===== The Earth alert (UI pass design § 9), a player's country pulse =====
# Each hostile fleet in flight to Earth, once per leg: loud (.111) while a
# landing would tip the balance at Earth (sr_earth_alert_loud, read once: it
# reads the location records and the fleets' strengths, which nothing here
# changes), else quiet (sr_earth_hostile_notice). The players told sit on the
# fleet's sr_fl_<n>_warned_<volume> lists. One popup a month, naming its
# fleet's owner (sr_earth_alert_by) and landing (sr_earth_alert_arrive): first
# pass, a loud fleet nobody was told of; second, the first loud one left. The
# month's other loud fleets are marked told, and each not yet told quietly
# gets its feed notice.
sr_earth_alert_step = {
	save_scope_as = sr_alert_viewer
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { sr_earth_alert_loud = yes } set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud value = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 0 }
	# First pass: the popup for a loud fleet nobody has been told of.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_war_with = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_1_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_2_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_3_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_4_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_5_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_6_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_7_dest var:sr_fl_7_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_7_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_8_dest var:sr_fl_8_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_8_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_9_dest var:sr_fl_9_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_9_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Second pass: every other fleet bound for Earth.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_war_with = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_1_arrive }
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_2_arrive }
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_3_arrive }
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }

						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }

						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }

# The Hostile Fleet cell's hover (sr_colony_overview_sgui, op 3): a line a power
# at war with the viewer with a fleet in flight to Earth, its name and its
# sr_disp_earth_power_* (read in its scope: gui_modding_guide.md gotcha #15).
sr_ov_list_earth = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_war_with = root
				OR = {
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_dest var:sr_fl_7_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_dest var:sr_fl_8_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_dest var:sr_fl_9_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc } }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = je_space_race_widget_ovc_earth_line
		}
	}
}
